title: A virtual proxy that loads the image once, on first real use

cases.says: Creating the proxy loads nothing; display() loads the real image and returns its answer, and isLoaded() then says true.
getFilename() answers from the proxy without loading the image.
display(), getSize() and display() again load the image once and reuse it.
When a second thread calls display() while the first is still loading, the loader still runs once and both get the same answer.
new VirtualImageProxy("  ", loader) throws IllegalArgumentException in the constructor, before any load.
